responsibility: Builds MIR bodies from THIR for functions, consts, and `custom_mir` inputs by orchestrating a shared lowering pipeline: the top-level builder coordinates standard versus custom construction, uses CFG primitives and small helper utilities to emit well-formed MIR, lowers blocks and lexical scopes with correct storage and drop behavior, converts expressions through coordinated constant/operand/place/rvalue/temporary/statement/destination-based paths, lowers pattern matching and `let` tests into guard-aware control flow with candidate simplification, test generation, and borrow utilities, and also supports injected custom MIR by parsing the custom DSL into complete MIR bodies and instructions.
